class: Six control rows stacked above the first suggestion card, two regions sharing one label, and no guidance or date provenance
fix: Instant chips and bulk bar share one tools row; the listing rules fold into a 'How this list works' disclosure; a first-look tip shows once (localStorage, progressive enhancement); each card's age carries a Found/Posted tooltip from discovered_view.age_title; the chips region is renamed so every label is unique. Template + CSS + 15 lines of JS; no Python logic changed.
prevention: New feed controls join the shared tools row instead of stacking; new regions get unique labels in the same change.
root_cause: Slices 1 and 2 added a bulk bar and a filter row without consolidating, duplicating the chips' label and burying the first card; the age line never said which date it was.
site: Suggested-jobs section, web_ui.py + discovered_view.py + static/cockpit.js/css, 3 November 2026
symptom: Six rows of controls sat above the first suggestion, two labelled regions shared a name, new filters went unannounced, and a card's age never said when the scan found it versus when it was posted.
why_tests_missed: Control tests checked names and routes one by one, never how many rows stacked above the content or whether two regions shared a label.
